_comment: Tracked recurring issues found by the weekly calibration agent. Each issue has: id, theme (or category, or null for global), first_observed (run_id), last_observed (run_id), status (open|monitoring|resolved), description, evidence_runs (list of run_ids), actions_taken (list of {run_date, action}), recommendation_pending (bool, true if the fix requires a human edit to a forbidden/prompt-level field).

issues.description: RESOLVED (monitoring): The catastrophic weekday theme score collapse that persisted from July 26 through August 10 (16 consecutive runs) appears to have been fixed by the August 11 rearchitecture introducing dimensional scoring (quality/relevance/local) and relative scaling for podcast theme scores. Pre-August 11 runs showed the familiar collapse pattern (Monday mean 8.2, Tuesday 3.1, Wednesday 9.1, Thursday 4.8), but post-August 11 ALL themes show healthy mean_theme_score_raw values: Monday 17.4–22.0, Tuesday 5.9–11.0, Wednesday 2.7–3.6, Thursday 7.7–18.0, with Friday/Saturday/Sunday maintaining strong scores (37.8–59.1 range). Podcast feeds now consistently hit target 100 articles across all themes, and holdover banks are robust (1113–1286 per theme as of August 16). The composite histograms post-August 11 show normal distributions rather than the pre-fix 0-19 concentration. Moving to monitoring status: need 3–4 more runs to confirm stability and ensure this isn't a transient spike from the infrastructure change itself.

actions_taken.action: None—this requires human review of scoring_prompt and theme_description fields for Monday/Tuesday/Wednesday/Thursday, which are in the forbidden auto-edit list. No auto-tunable knob (min_score, holdover_threshold, keyword additions) will fix a near-zero mean_theme_score caused by a scoring failure. Flagging as open recurring issue pending human intervention.

Monitoring mean_theme_score_raw trends across next 3–4 runs to confirm sustained recovery.
